note: DEFERRAL REGISTER — NOT AN ALLOWLIST. An allowlist entry says 'this removal is correct, stop reporting it'. A deferral says the opposite: 'this is a REAL LOSS, it is not fixed, and it is not forgiven'. Every id here is still counted, still printed, and still named in the guard report under UNRESOLVED REGRESSION. The register exists only so the pre-deploy gate can distinguish a known, owned, dated debt from a NEW silent drop, which remains a hard failure. Rules: (1) `npm run guard -- --strict` fails on these, and that is the mode the wave that restores them must reach; (2) if an id here is no longer dropped, the guard FAILS and tells you to delete the entry, so the register cannot rot; (3) adding an entry requires reason + owner + ticket + reviewBy, and is an owner decision, not a developer one.
